test_title: PYST 50 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Committee .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Committee"** is the correct spelling and refers to a group of people appointed for a specific function.
 
• Option 2 (**"Committy"**) is incorrect because it does not exist in the English language.
 
• Option 3 (**"Commitee"**) and Option 4 (**"Comitee"**) are misspelled versions of the word and therefore incorrect.

Correct word: ***Committee***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Definition:** Committee refers to a group of people appointed for a particular task or responsibility.
 
• **Example:** The planning committee met to discuss the upcoming event.
 
• **Usage:** Commonly used in organizational, governmental, or formal contexts.
